snapshot.cross_check: $1.2926 last trade on Kraken, 3:22 AM MDT (Kraken 24h range $1.2533 to $1.3138)

confirmed: XRP is about $1.29 early Sunday, up about 1.1% over 24 hours and roughly flat over 7 days (−0.01%), and about 17.6% below 30 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot, 3:22 AM MDT; Kraken last trade $1.2926, 24h range $1.2533 to $1.3138).

Crypto sold off broadly on Saturday as the US evacuated personnel across the Middle East over Iranian threats; bitcoin fell below $80,000 (low about $79,150) and XRP, ether and solana dropped 3% to 4% at the low before recovering. Bitcoin was back near $80,900 early Sunday (CoinDesk Oct 24; Investing.com Oct 25).

More than $800 million in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours, mostly bullish bets, as thin weekend trading amplified the drop (Coinglass via Investing.com, Oct 25). This tracker covers spot holdings only.

US spot XRP ETFs took in about $4.3M net from Oct 19 to 22 and had no net flows on Oct 23; cumulative net inflows are about $1.80B and net assets about $1.48B, below inflows because XRP's price has fallen since much of that money came in (SoSoValue via TokenPost and 24/7 Wall St., Oct 24). No ETF trading happens on weekends.

Franklin Templeton added about $150M of its tokenized money-market fund shares to the XRP Ledger, bringing its XRPL total to about $200M in a single wallet; these are fund shares, not XRP buys (CoinDesk, Oct 24).

Ripple's regular monthly escrow release of up to 1 billion XRP is scheduled for Nov 1 (00:00 UTC, which is 6 PM MDT Oct 31); in October 700M was re-locked and 300M stayed out (ledger data via TokenPost). This is routine, not new.

BlackRock's Max Stein is listed on an invite-only Swell panel about how asset managers build digital-asset strategies (Oct 27); a speaking slot is not a product announcement, and BlackRock has not filed for an XRP ETF (Swell agenda screenshots via Times Tabloid).

Arf, a Swiss-regulated payment-finance firm, partnered with Ripple to provide short-term RLUSD settlement loans on the XRP Ledger; a second phase depends on validator approval of the XLS-65/66 lending amendments (Arf, Ripple, Oct 22).
An XRP Ledger bug fix (fixCleanup3_4_0) was pushed from Oct 23 to about Nov 4 after validator support briefly dipped; support is now 31 of 35 (CoinDesk, Oct 22).

Ripple filed an Oct 20 letter backing the SEC's proposed crypto-asset rules and asking for clarity on when tokens stop being securities. The rules are not final and the letter does not change XRP's status (Crypto Briefing; Yahoo Finance).
Evernorth (XRPN) filed a preliminary, not-yet-effective S-1 on Oct 23 for up to 5.2M shares it may sell to Cantor (about $80.7M); the filing does not by itself confirm new XRP purchases (SEC filing).
not_confirmed: Ripple is not releasing 1.3 billion XRP on Nov 1: the scheduled escrow release is up to 1 billion XRP (about $1.3 billion in dollar terms at today's price). No BlackRock XRP ETF filing or BlackRock–Ripple deal exists; BlackRock's Max Stein speaking on a Swell panel is not an announcement. Ripple has not signed a '$10 billion' partner; that figure is Arf's annual settlement volume, and viral '$45.50' targets have no basis. Evernorth's Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo execution partners were announced Oct 14 and are being reposted as 'just in'. Also still unconfirmed from earlier: no Bank of America–Ripple partnership, no Trump family quote about XRP, and Ripple's bank charter is still only a preliminary conditional approval. 'Ripple × Xaman airdrop' posts and 'QFS' or move-your-coins messages fit common scam patterns; Xaman says it does not run airdrops. Details are in the rumors section.

Ripple's annual conference; keynotes include Garlinghouse, Matt Damon and Gary White (Water.org), Bullish CEO Tom Farley; DriveWealth fireside on Oct 28.

news.headline: XRP Ledger bug fix moved to November after validator support dipped for two hours
news.summary: Support for fixCleanup3_4_0 briefly fell to 26 of 35 validators, resetting its 14-day clock; activation moves from Oct 23 to about Nov 4, and support is now 31 of 35.

news.headline: Ripple brings Wall Street into 24/7 bets, but HSBC warns of thin orderbooks
news.summary: HSBC's head of digital assets research called Ripple Prime's new swaps evolutionary, not revolutionary, and said limited liquidity may restrict large trades at first.

news.headline: DTCC prepares to tokenize $30 trillion in assets across 25 securities
news.summary: DTCC's Tokenization Service is due to launch this month on Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network; Stellar and Circle's Arc are expected in 2027. XRPL is not named.

news.headline: Arf and Ripple partner to bring settlement liquidity to the XRP Ledger
news.summary: Swiss-regulated Arf (about $10B a year in settlement volume) will lend RLUSD on XRPL to licensed payment firms for 1 to 5 days. A later phase depends on validators approving the XLS-65/66 lending amendments. No RLUSD amount was disclosed.

news.headline: CryptEscrow and Ripple announce strategic partnership to advance crypto-powered real estate settlement
news.summary: Press release from CryptEscrow (Miami) describing a partnership pairing its regulated crypto-to-fiat real estate closing service with Ripple's infrastructure. No financial terms, volumes or XRP-specific mechanics were disclosed, and it is not yet listed on Ripple's own press page.

news.headline: Hold RLUSD in any Binance account to share 600,000 XRP rewards
news.summary: Binance campaign running Oct 23 to Nov 20 (UTC): eligible users holding at least 0.01 RLUSD share a 600,000 XRP pool paid weekly on Fridays starting Oct 30. KYC and supported regions only; the US is among excluded jurisdictions. A promotion, not a change to XRP itself.

news.headline: Ripple urges SEC to finalize crypto rules, clarify when tokens cease to be securities
news.summary: In an Oct 20 comment letter, Ripple backed the SEC's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets framework and asked for clearer rules on when an investment contract ends and how secondary-market trading is treated. This is a public comment, not a rule change.

news.headline: Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand central banks expand cross-border stablecoin initiative involving Ripple, Visa and Mastercard
news.summary: MAS confirmed Bank Negara Malaysia and the Bank of Thailand joined its BLOOM initiative as policymaker members. Ripple is one of many participants (with Visa, Mastercard, Circle, Coinbase, JPMorgan); its role, announced in March, is a trial of RLUSD trade payments on the XRP Ledger.

news.headline: Evernorth files preliminary S-1 for up to 5.2M shares under a Cantor equity facility
news.summary: The Ripple-backed XRP treasury company (Nasdaq: XRPN) registered up to 5,218,935 shares it may sell to Cantor, about $80.7M at the cover price. The filing is not yet effective and does not itself confirm new XRP purchases. A separate Oct 19 prospectus covers 11.5M shares issuable from warrants.

news.headline: U.S. spot XRP ETFs post $3.55 million in daily net inflows
news.summary: Oct 22 net inflow of $3.55M, all into Franklin's XRPZ; second straight day of inflows after $0.71M on Oct 21. Cumulative net inflows about $1.80B; net assets about $1.49B.

news.headline: XRP News: Ripple joined DTCC's tokenization push this week. Can it pull XRP out of its October slide?
news.summary: Notes Ripple Prime has been in DTCC's tokenization working group since May 4 (not new), that DTCC's first production trades ran on Besu and Canton without the XRP Ledger, and that no DTCC commitment to use XRP exists. XRP was about $1.31, down about 12% in October.

news.headline: XRP defends $1.30 support as Ripple partners with Arf to bring RLUSD settlement liquidity to XRPL
news.summary: Technical commentary: XRP held near $1.30 after Thursday's drop, with the 50-, 100- and 200-day averages overhead. Analysis, not a forecast to act on.

news.headline: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million of money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
news.summary: Two $75M subscriptions brought Franklin's tokenized money-market fund (sgBENJI) on XRPL to about 193M shares, roughly $200M, all held in one wallet that shares signers with Franklin's issuing account. Who the investors are is undisclosed. These are fund shares, not XRP purchases.

news.headline: U.S. spot XRP ETFs record no net flows on Oct 23, ending a two-day inflow run
news.summary: Flat flows on Oct 23 after inflows on Oct 21 and 22. Cumulative net inflows about $1.81B; net assets about $1.48B; daily trading volume $18.8M.

news.headline: Ripple prepares 80+ sessions at Swell 2026 as banks and developers gather for three days in New York
news.summary: Swell runs Oct 27–29 at The Shed in Manhattan with 100+ speakers including executives from CME, BNY, Robinhood and ICE, and is combined with XRPL Apex and UBRI Connect this year. Agenda preview only; no announcements are confirmed in advance.

news.headline: Crypto under weekend pressure: bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
news.summary: The WSJ reported the US is evacuating personnel across the Middle East on threat of Iranian attacks; bitcoin fell to its weakest level in more than a month and XRP, ether and solana were down 3% to 4% at the time.

news.headline: Bitcoin price today: BTC recovers to $80,800 ahead of Fed meeting
news.summary: Bitcoin bounced from a Saturday low of about $79,146; more than $810M of crypto positions were liquidated in 24 hours (Coinglass). Traders are watching the Fed's Oct 27–28 meeting and Brent oil above $117.

news.headline: Trump says Iran strikes could come today. Can bitcoin hold $80,000?
news.summary: President Trump said the US could strike Iran as soon as Sunday or reach a deal instead; the piece reviews how bitcoin moved on earlier Iran headlines this month. Context for weekend volatility, not XRP-specific.

news.headline: XRP ETFs took in just $4.3 million in a week. Could WisdomTree's fund change that?
news.summary: Using SoSoValue data, spot XRP ETFs took in $4.3M from Oct 19 to 22 and nothing on Oct 23. Cumulative inflows are $1.80B but assets are $1.48B, mainly because XRP's price has fallen.

news.headline: The IMF and BlackRock are both speaking at Ripple Swell 2026
news.summary: Screenshots of Swell's invite-only Platinum Summit agenda show BlackRock's Max Stein on an asset-manager panel and the IMF's Tobias Adrian on a stablecoin panel on Oct 27. Panel slots only; no product news.

news.headline: Ripple schedules up to 1 billion XRP escrow release for Nov. 1, 2026
news.summary: Routine monthly escrow unlock at 00:00 UTC Nov 1. In October, 700M of the 1B released was re-locked. How much stays out or is sold is not known in advance.

claims.claim: Why is Ripple planning to release 1.3 billion XRP on November 1st instead of 1 billion? ... a BlackRock ETF or some type of announcement?
claims.check: The scheduled Nov 1 escrow release is up to 1 billion XRP, the same as every month; about $1.3 billion is its dollar value at today's price, not a bigger unlock. Nothing links it to BlackRock. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: Ripple schedules up to 1 billion XRP escrow release for Nov. 1

claims.claim: BlackRock's Max Stein highlights a blockchain-agnostic future as XRP ETF rumors surface; holders watch his Swell appearance for signals
claims.check: Stein is listed on a Swell panel and has said BlackRock is 'agnostic to the blockchain', but he did not name XRP, and BlackRock has not filed for or announced an XRP ETF. 'Watch for signals' is speculation. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: CoinTurk: BlackRock's Max Stein highlights blockchain-agnostic future

claims.claim: XRP supercycle incoming? $45.50 price target viral as Ripple secures massive $10B payments partner
claims.who: @barronturmp8 (name mimics Barron Trump), copied by other accounts
claims.check: Misreads the Arf partnership: $10B is Arf's own annual settlement volume, not a deal size or committed XRP Ledger volume, and the deal uses RLUSD, not XRP. The price target has no source. Lookalike account name. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: Arf: Arf and Ripple partner to bring settlement liquidity to the XRP Ledger

claims.claim: JUST IN: Evernorth named Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as execution partners to begin deploying its 473 million XRP treasury
claims.check: Real, but old: Evernorth announced this on Oct 14, subject to closing conditions and approvals, with no amounts disclosed. Reposting it as 'just in' makes it look new.

claims.claim: BREAKING: BlackRock just signed a massive $6.5 TRILLION XRP tokenization deal
claims.who: @DonaldTrumlf (display name 'Commentary Donald Trump jr.', an unverified lookalike account; about 14 views)
claims.check: No source given, and no BlackRock or Ripple announcement or mainstream report of any such deal exists; the figure is larger than BlackRock's entire assets under management. The account impersonates a public figure's name. No mainstream corroboration.

claims.claim: Franklin Templeton just added $192 million worth of $XRP
claims.check: Misreads a real story. CoinDesk reports Franklin Templeton put about $150M of its tokenized money-market fund shares (sgBENJI) on the XRP Ledger, for about $200M total; those are fund shares issued on the ledger, not purchases of XRP.
claims.check_title: CoinDesk: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million of money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger

claims.claim: The Ripple × Xaman Anniversary XRP Airdrop is now LIVE
claims.who: @XRPL_Fndt (display name 'XAM | WALLET'; about 9.6K views), promoted in replies to Xaman's official account
claims.check: Likely impersonation scam. The account is not Xaman's official @XamanWallet, and Xaman's help center says it does not run airdrops or giveaways. On Oct 23 an X user (@libertine1042) posted that all 1,633 of their XRP left their wallet after opening a 'Xaman airdrop', and so-called 'recovery' accounts then replied offering help, a common follow-up scam. Never connect a wallet, sign a transaction, or enter secret numbers on a 'claim' page, and ignore unsolicited recovery offers. Links deliberately not opened. No mainstream corroboration.

claims.claim: BlackRock XRP ETF announcement at Ripple Swell next week?
claims.check: Posed as a question with no source. BlackRock has never filed for a spot XRP ETF, per The Motley Fool (Oct 6) and other reviews of SEC filings; Swell's published agenda has a session on the first year of spot XRP ETFs but names no BlackRock filing. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: The Motley Fool: BlackRock has no plans to launch an XRP ETF

claims.claim: Ripple CTO emeritus David Schwartz: a world where XRPL succeeds in finance but XRP lacks high demand and value is 'very unlikely'
claims.check: The post is real and his own words, but it is his opinion about the future, not a forecast with numbers or a company announcement. Price targets attached to it in replies (for example $10,000 per XRP) are not his. No mainstream coverage of the thread found.

claims.claim: Russia's VTB will launch XRP trading for retail customers next month and recommends allocating up to 7% to XRP
claims.check: VTB says it plans to open crypto trading to retail investors in November and December, but Russia's rules limit ordinary retail buyers to the most liquid coins (Bitcoin, Ether and USDT named), capped at 300,000 roubles a year. No source shows XRP on VTB's menu or a 7% recommendation. No mainstream corroboration of the XRP part.
claims.check_title: DL News: Sberbank and VTB ready retail trading

claims.claim: Evernorth is about to buy more XRP with a filing for 11.5M new XRPN shares
claims.check: The filings are real: an Oct 19 prospectus for 11.5M shares issuable if public warrants are exercised at $11.50, and a new Oct 23 S-1 for up to 5.2M shares via Cantor. Evernorth says it intends to raise money to grow its XRP treasury, but neither filing confirms a purchase, and the warrant shares are not new stock sold by the company today.

claims.claim: BREAKING: USA begins process of paying $35 trillion in debt using XRP; XRP to hit $371
claims.check: No Treasury, Congress or news source reports anything like this, and no source is cited. A recurring hype template. No mainstream corroboration.

claims.claim: BREAKING: Ripple and Bank of America partnership officially confirmed
claims.check: No such announcement on Ripple's press page or in any mainstream or crypto outlet. The documented link is older and narrower: Bank of America is a long-listed RippleNet member, connects through Ripple Treasury's bank gateway, and disclosed a small XRP ETF holding in a Feb 2026 SEC filing. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: BSC News: what XRP's relationship with banks actually looks like

claims.claim: Garlinghouse 'just opened the door' to XRP reaching Bitcoin's price; 'XRP is the next Bitcoin'
claims.check: No quote or interview cited, and no outlet reports Garlinghouse saying this. Matching XRP's per-coin price to Bitcoin's would imply a market value far above all crypto combined; treat as hype. No mainstream corroboration.

claims.claim: BlackRock x Ripple: a big announcement is coming that will send shockwaves through the XRP community
claims.check: Not corroborated. No BlackRock or Ripple announcement found; mainstream and crypto press report BlackRock still has no XRP ETF plans. Posts give no source, only a 'feeling'.
claims.check_title: Crypto Briefing, Oct 6: BlackRock still has no plans for an XRP ETF

claims.claim: Trump's son says there's no replacement for XRP; 'secure XRP and set up your QFS Web3 account'
claims.check: No report of such a quote found in any outlet. 'QFS account' pitches are a known crypto-scam pattern; never move coins or enter a seed phrase because of a post like this.

claims.claim: Garlinghouse is hinting XRP will join America's financial system; projections above $30,000 per XRP; 'move your asset to a decentralized wallet'
claims.check: No new Garlinghouse statement found that says this, and the price figure has no source. Urging holders to move coins is a common scam lead-in.

claims.claim: Garlinghouse said at HDAX 'this morning' that 'the vote today' has no bearing on XRP
claims.check: Appears recycled: the HDAX fireside with Esther George was Sep 14–15, and the only recent Senate CLARITY Act vote (failed cloture) was Sep 15. No crypto vote took place Oct 22.
claims.check_title: Kansas City Digital Drive: HDAX returns to Kansas City

claims.claim: Germany's largest stock exchange says XRP will be the backbone of the new financial system, with $7 to $9 soon and $100+ later
claims.check: No exchange statement found. Deutsche Börse's own material describes its D7 platform, not XRP; its Clearstream unit added XRP to a custody list in July 2026, which is custody, not adoption as a settlement layer. The copy-paste pattern suggests coordinated promotion. Still recirculating on Oct 24.
claims.check_title: Clearstream: six new cryptocurrencies added to custody offering

claims.claim: BlackRock XRP ETF next, with XRP to $249.78 very soon
claims.check: BlackRock told The Block it had no plans to file an XRP ETF, and an Oct 6, 2026 Motley Fool piece says it has never filed one. No filing found in an ETF filing tracker. The price figure has no stated basis.
claims.check_title: The Motley Fool, Oct 6: BlackRock has no plans to launch an XRP ETF
